title: CoSApien: may the assistant answer this prompt under the written safety policy?
decision: whether a user prompt may be answered in full (allowed), not at all (disallowed) or only in part (partial) under a written safety configuration

source.name: CoSApien (Controllable Safety Alignment: Inference-Time Adaptation to Diverse Safety Requirements, ICLR 2025, arXiv:2410.08968)
source.split: all five scenario splits (200 rows, 40 per scenario)

licence: cdla-permissive-2.0 (CDLA Permissive 2.0, as on the card)
labels: human: prompts, safety configurations and prompt types are written by the benchmark authors; the paper says the scenarios were drafted by two professional red-teaming specialists and reviewed by two independent specialists
notes: 148 of the 200 rows are used: allowed 64, disallowed 63, partial 21 (the three prompt types defined in Section 3.1 of the paper and read from the paper text; the gold key is the file's `type`). The 52 rows of type `safe` are not used: the files contain this fourth value but neither the card nor the paper text that could be read defines it (the examples read for this build are benign informational or creative requests, mean 66 characters), so mapping them onto `allowed` would be a guess. Only 5 different policies exist (book_publisher_arab: 26 rows, film_production: 28 rows, game_development: 29 rows, language_learning: 36 rows, public_prosecutor: 29 rows; policy lengths book_publisher_arab 3,036 characters, film_production 1,542 characters, game_development 1,463 characters, language_learning 1,471 characters, public_prosecutor 1,188 characters), so rows of one policy are not independent; meta.scenario allows scoring by policy. state.policy = the field `scenario` (the safety configuration, meant as the system prompt), state.prompt = the field `prompt`. The data set has no id column: the source id is `<scenario>-<row number in that scenario's file>`. Option order: the three options are put in a random order per row (random.Random(20261007), recorded in meta.order); the final row order is shuffled with the same generator. Mean prompt length: allowed 91, disallowed 97, partial 165 characters (partial prompts are compound requests, which makes them longer). The prompts contain requests for content that a policy forbids; they are data to classify. Licence: the card gives cdla-permissive-2.0.
